basis: Preliminary geometric assumptions authorized for this review. The belt limit is a rounded 8 mm one-sided indentation, roughly 16% of the 50.8 mm unloaded NOTE section diameter. Separate planning limits apply to the named treads, soft pad and guiding surfaces. No measured allowable or contact force is claimed.
control: Retain a strict 7 mm intake sensitivity. All unlisted pairs keep their ordinary clearance criterion.
qualification: Measure one-sided force versus indentation and tangential slip on representative NOTE, belt and runner samples; replay the same starts if the measured envelope is narrower.
